"Iran continues to try to hit U.S. naval ships, and for every time they do that or try to do that, ​they’re going to lose tankers," Rubio told reporters, Reuters reported.

Iran subsequently launched ballistic missiles toward a U.S. base near Al Azraq in Jordan, the report added, citing an IRGC statement carried by state media. However, Jordan said its air defenses intercepted 18 of 20 missiles, with no reported casualties.
